Written by Jeremy Yan | 02/18/2026


Searching for a trusted Foreign Credential Evaluation Service in the United States?

You've likely come across AICE (Association of International Credential Evaluators, Inc.) as one of the two main accrediting bodies for credential evaluation agencies in the USA. Both set rigorous standards — but AICE takes a uniquely research-driven, standards-first approach that many universities, licensing boards, HR departments, and USCIS recognize and trust.

Before you order an evaluation, you probably have many questions:


  • What is AICE and why does it matter for my credential evaluation?
  • Which AICE member agencies are the most reputable?
  • How much does an AICE member evaluation cost?
  • How long does an AICE evaluation take?
  • Do I need to mail physical documents or can I submit scans?
  • Which agencies are accepted by USCIS, universities, and employers?

Today, we review the best AICE Endorsed Member agencies — plus AET (American Education & Translation Services), a highly trusted, USCIS-accepted evaluator — to help you make the best choice for your situation in 2026.

Whether you need a Foreign Credential Evaluation for immigration, employment, education, or licensing, this guide covers it all.

What Is AICE and Why Does It Matter?

AICE (Association of International Credential Evaluators, Inc.) is a non-profit professional membership organization dedicated to establishing standards and best practices in the international credentials evaluation field. Founded over 27 years ago, AICE:

  • Sets rigorous, peer-reviewed evaluation standards that endorsed members must follow.
  • Requires a thorough, independent site visit before granting Endorsed Membership.
  • Mandates senior evaluators have at least 5 years of experience.
  • Is endorsed by the U.S. Department of Education, AACRAO, and Norway's NOKUT.
  • Accepted by USCIS, universities, employers, and licensing boards across the United States.

When a state, university, or employer requires an evaluation from an AICE member, you can trust any of the agencies listed above to meet that requirement.

Why Choose American Education & Translation Services (AET)?

AET — American Education & Translation Services — stands apart with:

  • No physical mailing required: Just ask your old school and send scanned copies by email for evaluation — the fastest, easiest submission process in the industry.
  • Perfect track record: Zero USCIS rejections or RFEs in over 15 years of service and tens of thousands of evaluations completed.
  • Custom evaluation reports: Includes second majors or minors when sufficient credits are earned, boosting acceptance for employment-based immigration cases (EB-2/EB-3).
  • Fast, affordable, and transparent: Clear timelines, rush options, and the lowest industry pricing starting at just $100.
  • USCIS-recognized evaluators: Our Director of Evaluation has 15+ years of experience, including 10+ years as a senior associate director at a prominent NACES agency.
  • A+ BBB Rating: Trusted by thousands of clients across all 50 states and around the world.

Final Thoughts: Choose the Best Credential Evaluation Service Today

Every AICE member agency on this list is a high-quality, standards-compliant credential evaluator. Whether you need an evaluation for immigration (USCIS), employment, education, or professional licensing, you can trust any of these agencies to deliver an authoritative, widely-accepted evaluation report.
